northStar: Paying subscribers ($29.99/mo). Every active lesson must include subscriberImpact.

lessons.subscriberImpact: Broken search links kill trust and enroll clicks from listed pros who check the site.
lessons.lesson: Campaign search links must use canonical category slugs (e.g. plumbing), not informal plurals (plumbers).
lessons.evidence: Links with category=plumbers did not match opened search until normalizeCategory fix on dev.
lessons.do: Pass --category from lib/categories.ts; dry-run and click search URL before a wave.
lessons.dont: Guess category strings from trade names.

lessons.subscriberImpact: Listed pros ignore or distrust add-me cold copy; honest listed copy is required for enroll replies.
lessons.lesson: Wave 1 pros are already on the site — subject/body must say that honestly, not ask permission to add them.
lessons.evidence: DEFAULT_MESSAGE still reads like cold add-request; strategy doc calls for listed-pro copy.
lessons.do: Use --wave listed and listed-pro copy when implemented; until then customize body or pause Wave 1 mass send.
lessons.dont: Send Wave 1 at scale with can-I-add-you copy.

lessons.subscriberImpact: Listed-pro subject/body increases trust and enroll clicks vs cold add-me copy.
lessons.lesson: Wave 1 sends must use --wave listed (LISTED_MESSAGE + listed subject in lib/campaigns.ts / lib/email.ts).
lessons.evidence: First live Wave 1 to TE Certified 2026-10-15 with listed copy; Resend 01a14184-b0d2-798c-98d4-651077c168c7.
lessons.do: campaign-manager-send.ts --wave listed for every curated on-site pro.
lessons.dont: Use DEFAULT_MESSAGE for businesses already in search results.

lessons.subscriberImpact: No email on curated row means zero outreach until discovery — blocks all Wave 1 revenue.
lessons.lesson: Production curated_businesses had contact_email null for all 20 listings; discover from public website contact pages only.
lessons.evidence: Neon production query 2026-10-15; TE email found on /contact as info@emailte.com.
lessons.do: Run campaign-sync-listed-prospects.ts; discover via unblock-yourself.md; verify on site before send; update prospects row; keep going same session.
lessons.dont: Guess emails, scrape purchased lists, or stop the run waiting on owner for routine discovery.

lessons.subscriberImpact: Campaign stalls with zero sends if agent waits on owner for emails that are findable on public sites.
lessons.lesson: Under STANDALONE, missing email means run discovery (WebFetch contact pages, WebSearch, helpers) — not end session or ask owner.
lessons.evidence: Owner directive 2026-10-15; early session stopped after one send while 16 prospects still needs_email.
lessons.do: Follow docs/campaigns/skills/unblock-yourself.md until cap hit or prospects skipped with skipReason.
lessons.dont: Report blocked for missing email without attempting contact/home/search passes.

lessons.subscriberImpact: No working send or compliant unsub means zero outreach and compliance risk — no subscribers.
lessons.lesson: vercel env pull can leave UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET empty; local sends fail or break unsub links without a fallback.
lessons.evidence: Empty strings in .env.campaign-send.local; vercel env run on Windows did not inject secrets.
lessons.do: Set UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET (or CRON_SECRET) in env for --prepare; verify non-empty before a wave.
lessons.dont: Assume pulled env is send-ready without checking secret length.

lessons.subscriberImpact: Mail in junk never produces replies or trials; ramp only when inbox placement is acceptable.
lessons.lesson: Owner mail (ImprovMX inbound + campaign BCC) goes to gui.quickprolist@gmail.com — check inbox and spam before raising cap.
lessons.evidence: ImprovMX forward off Hotmail 2026-10-16; default BCC updated to same Gmail.
lessons.do: Log Gmail placement after tests (BCC on sends + mail to contact@quickprolist.com).
lessons.dont: Raise daily cap before clean Gmail placement; do not document Hotmail as owner inbox.

lessons.subscriberImpact: Reputation damage from bursts reduces inbox placement — fewer pros ever see the offer.
lessons.lesson: Fast campaign means fast decisions, not API bursts — ≥90s between sends, ≤2 pro sends per 20m tick, cap 10 until inbox confirmed.
lessons.evidence: Owner asked about mass send; 4 pros in ~4 min on 2026-10-15 was faster than policy.
lessons.do: One send process; ≥90s apart; ≤2 pro sends per tick; spread daily cap; stay at 10 until owner confirms BCC inbox.
lessons.dont: Parallel scripts, send-all-at-once, or raise cap before inbox gate.

lessons.subscriberImpact: Double-emailing a pro destroys trust and unsubscribes — kills the only path to that subscriber.
lessons.lesson: sent-registry.json is canonical for who was emailed; board tables are summaries only.
lessons.evidence: Double-email risk without registry; send script enforces dedupe.
lessons.do: campaign-list-sent.ts --email= before send; sync prospects-registry status after success.
lessons.dont: Rely on board Sent log alone to decide if someone was mailed.

lessons.subscriberImpact: Stopping after listed pros leaves 3rd-slot and cold pipeline empty — no path to more paid subs.
lessons.lesson: Campaign runs continuously: Wave 1 → Wave 2 → follow-up → next wedge in every session/tick until PAUSED or daily cap.
lessons.evidence: Owner 2026-10-15: keep running past Wave 1 for subscribers.
lessons.do: Follow continuous-campaign.md priority stack; shift to outreach discovery when listed pipeline is slow.
lessons.dont: End session with only Wave 1 work done while cap or hours remain.

lessons.subscriberImpact: MCP send without --finalize skips sent-registry dedupe and risks double-emailing pros.
lessons.lesson: Campaign delivery is Resend MCP only: --prepare → MCP (idempotencyKey) → --finalize --resend-id.
lessons.evidence: Owner 2026-10-16: MCP-only policy for all campaign outreach.
lessons.do: Connect Resend MCP + Neon MCP (neon-mcp.md); UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET runtime secret; always --finalize after MCP.

lessons.subscriberImpact: Mailing up to the owner-approved board cap reaches more pros; pacing and a 5% bounce pause keep that mail in the inbox so it can become paid subscribers.
lessons.lesson: Daily cap is whatever board.md states (currently 25, owner-approved 2026-10-17). The BCC/forwarding inbox gui.quickprolist@gmail.com is confirmed receiving. Keep ≥90s between sends and ≤2 pro sends per tick. Pause if the rolling bounce rate on real prospect sends exceeds 5%.
lessons.evidence: Owner voice 2026-10-17 set the cap at 25. Owner forwarding tests on 2026-10-16 arrived in the gui.quickprolist@gmail.com inbox, and campaign BCC copies arrive. Supersedes 2026-10-15-send-pacing.
lessons.do: Honor the Daily email cap on board.md — do not substitute 10. One send process; ≥90s apart; ≤2 pro sends per tick; spread that cap across the day. Pause if the rolling bounce rate on real prospect sends exceeds 5%.
lessons.dont: Refuse sends above a stale cap of 10, run parallel send scripts, or send-all-at-once. Do not keep sending after the real-prospect bounce rate exceeds 5%.
